hints.title: Strictly Increasing Cell Chains
hints.text: Every valid path of length 1 or more consists of steps transitioning strictly to cells with strictly larger values.

hints.title: Directed Acyclic Substructure
hints.text: Because values strictly increase along edges, the transitions form a directed acyclic graph without cycles.

hints.title: Memoized Exploration
hints.text: Compute paths starting at cell (r, c) as 1 plus the sum of paths from all four adjacent cells with strictly larger values.

hints.title: Memoized Grid DFS Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is memoized once and explores at most 4 edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive recursive path enumeration visits cells exponentially many times.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization cache stores paths for m by n cells.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models the grid transition relation as a DAG and uses memoization to achieve linear time.
